title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Renewal Reserve Held Against Credit Refunds
content:
**Renewal reserve (Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs).** On a lender's request for a refund of the program credit balance, Tidemark holds back from the refundable credit, without taking it below zero, a reserve for renewals about to be billed, estimated from the renewal notices mailed in the last month: when the required amounts on those notices average at least the amount at which the tier's building rate per 100 reaches the tier's minimum certificate premium, the reserve is the sum of those required amounts divided by 100 times the tier's building rate per 100; when they average less, the reserve is the tier's minimum certificate premium for each such notice; with no such notice the reserve is zero.

**Terms.**
- *Renewal notices mailed in the last month:* the program's renewal notices whose notice date lies in the window of the last 1 month, that window covering every entry dated on a day from which fewer than 1 whole calendar month has passed by today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.
- *The amount at which the tier's building rate reaches the minimum premium:* the tier's minimum certificate premium divided by the tier's building rate per 100, multiplied by 100.
- The tier figures are those of the program's own tier in the product's rate schedule.

## Method by case

| Renewal notices in the last month | Average required amount | Reserve |
|---|---|---|
| None | — | Zero |
| One or more | At least the break-even amount | Sum of the required amounts divided by 100, times the tier's building rate per 100 |
| One or more | Below the break-even amount | The tier's minimum certificate premium for each notice |

## Hypothetical illustration (invented tier figures: rate 1.25 per 100, minimum premium 275 dollars)

Break-even amount: 275 divided by 1.25, times 100, is 22,000 dollars.
- Three notices for 48,000, 61,000 and 35,000 dollars average 48,000 dollars; reserve 144,000 divided by 100, times 1.25, that is 1,800.00 dollars.
- Two notices for 9,000 and 14,000 dollars average 11,500 dollars, below 22,000 dollars; reserve 2 times 275, that is 550.00 dollars.
